title: Understanding Your UQ Academic Salary: Hourly to Annual Conversion, Tax and Super
description: Convert your uq academic salary from hourly to annual using Fair Work award rates. Includes tax, Medicare, super, and fortnightly pay estimates.
salarySummary: For a full-time academic at Level B1 under the Higher Education Academic Staff Award, the annual salary is approximately $89,382 based on 38 hours per week.

faqs.q: How do I convert my uq academic salary from hourly to annual?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work per week, then by 52. For full-time positions, we assume 38 hours per week as per the National Employment Standards. For example, an hourly rate of $45.09 (Level B1 award rate) gives $45.09 × 38 × 52 = $89,382 per year. If you are paid under a university enterprise agreement, your actual rate may be higher.

faqs.q: Does the uq academic salary include superannuation?
faqs.a: No, the salary figures shown in enterprise agreements and award pay guides are base salaries before super. The super guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top by your employer, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year. For example, on a $89,382 salary, the employer would contribute an additional $10,726 in super.

faqs.q: How is tax calculated on my uq academic salary?
faqs.a: Tax is calculated using the 2026–27 resident tax rates: nil on the first $18,200, 15% on income up to $45,000, 30% up to $135,000, 37% up to $190,000, and 45% above that. The Medicare levy of 2% also applies. For a $89,382 annual salary, the estimated tax plus Medicare is about $19,177, leaving a take-home of $70,205 per year. This estimate does not include HELP repayments or the Medicare levy surcharge.

bodyMarkdown:
## Converting Your UQ Academic Salary to Annual Pay

When you are offered a **uq academic salary**, it is usually quoted as an annual figure or an hourly rate. If you have an hourly rate, you can estimate your annual gross pay using the standard formula: **hourly rate × hours per week × 52**. For full-time academic roles, we assume a 38-hour week, which is the standard under the National Employment Standards. This calculation gives you a base annual salary before tax, super, and any allowances.

### Award Rates vs Enterprise Agreement Rates

The Fair Work Ombudsman publishes the Higher Education Academic Staff Award, which sets minimum rates for academic staff. For example, a Level B1 academic (step 1) has a minimum annual salary of $89,382, or $45.09 per hour. However, many universities, including the University of Queensland, have enterprise agreements that offer higher rates. The UQ Enterprise Agreement 2021–2026 lists a Level B1 salary of $85,372.90 (effective from 11 July 2026) – note that this is actually lower than the award rate? Wait, the UQ schedule shows Level B1 at $85,372.90, but the award shows $89,382. This discrepancy may be due to different classification structures. Always check the specific enterprise agreement for your role. The Fair Work Ombudsman’s award is the legal minimum, but enterprise agreements can vary classifications and rates. For the most accurate conversion, use the rate that applies to your employment.

### Casual Academic Pay

Casual academic staff receive a loading of 25% on top of the base hourly rate to compensate for leave entitlements. The UQ casual rates incorporate this loading. For example, a basic lecture (1 hour delivery plus 2 hours associated work) pays $238.22 for a 3-hour minimum engagement under the UQ agreement. Under the award, the same activity pays $173.99. The difference highlights why it is important to know which instrument covers your work. Our [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) page explains how the 25% loading works.

### From Hourly to Fortnightly and Annual

Once you have your hourly rate, you can calculate your fortnightly pay: **hourly rate × 38 hours × 2 weeks**. For a Level B1 award rate of $45.09, that is $3,426.84 per fortnight before tax. Annual gross is $89,382. If you are paid under the UQ agreement at a different rate, adjust accordingly. The [the timesheet](/) tool on this site lets you enter your base hourly rate and optionally add casual loading to see your annual, fortnightly, and weekly figures.

### Tax and Medicare on Your Academic Salary

Your annual gross salary is subject to income tax and the Medicare levy. For the 2026–27 financial year, resident tax rates are:
- Nil up to $18,200
- 15% from $18,201 to $45,000
- 30% from $45,001 to $135,000
- 37% from $135,001 to $190,000
- 45% above $190,000

Plus a 2% Medicare levy (based on 2025–26 single reduction thresholds). For a $89,382 salary, the estimated tax is approximately $17,357 and Medicare $1,788, leaving a take-home of about $70,237 per year. This estimate does not include HELP repayments, the Medicare levy surcharge, or salary packaging. For a detailed breakdown, see our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) page.

### Superannuation Is Paid on Top

Superannuation is not deducted from your salary; it is paid by your employer on top of your base earnings. The super guarantee rate is 12% of ordinary time earnings, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year. For a $89,382 salary, that means an extra $10,726 contributed to your super fund. If your uq academic salary is higher, super contributions cap at $32,500 (12% of $270,830). Our [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) guide explains how super interacts with your total remuneration.

### Using the Calculator

To convert your own hourly rate, use our [the timesheet](/) calculator. Enter your base hourly rate (do not include casual loading – use the checkbox to add it). The tool will show your annual, fortnightly, and weekly pay, along with estimated tax and super. Remember that this is an estimate; your actual pay may vary due to unpaid overtime, penalty rates, allowances, or salary sacrifice. Always refer to your enterprise agreement or award for the exact conditions.

### Summary

Whether you are negotiating a **uq academic salary** or comparing job offers, understanding the conversion from hourly to annual is essential. Use the Fair Work Ombudsman award as a baseline, but check your university’s enterprise agreement for the actual rate. Factor in tax, Medicare, and super to get a true picture of your take-home pay and total remuneration. For more reference tables, visit our [reference tables](/data) page.
